mapper.update: UPDATE mac_admin SET admin_last_login_time = admin_login_time, admin_last_login_ip = admin_login_ip, admin_login_time = #{now}, admin_login_ip = #{ip}, admin_login_num = admin_login_num + 1, admin_random = #{random} WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND admin_pwd = #{pwd} AND admin_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_admin (admin_name, admin_pwd, admin_status, admin_auth) VALUES (#{name}, #{pwd}, #{status}, #{auth})
